Policy: Course access, participation, and submission privileges require valid course enrollment. Enrolled users hold distinct course-scoped roles (Student, TA, Professor), and role authority in one course does not confer privileges in other courses.

My name is Kavita Rao, and my username is student07. My global institutional role is student.
Hello Kavita Rao. I can help with the LMS. Which course or institutional area are you working in?
The course involved is CSE301, where my effective course-specific role is Student. My group membership in this course is Design Team Gamma.
Understood. What would you like me to do in that scope?

My requested task is: Access course overview, syllabus modules, and announcements for CSE301. The operation is VIEW. The target resource is CSE301 Course Portal. The target owner is Department of Computer Science.
I will attempt to view CSE301 Course Portal in CSE301.
